step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard architecture diagram shows two main partitions: Customer/AWS on the left and Snyk infrastructure on the right. On the left side, under Customer, there is a CodePipeline icon connected bidirectionally to an S3 Objects bucket and bidirectionally to an AWS CodePipeline icon under the AWS label. On the right side (Snyk infrastructure), AWS CodePipeline connects to API Gateway (which connects bidirectionally to DynamoDB) for initial setup and authentication. For continuous scanning flows, AWS CodePipeline triggers Lambda, which writes state into EventBridge. EventBridge interacts bidirectionally with Step Functions, which performs complex scan logic and reports results back to AWS CodePipeline. All nodes are extracted using exact AWS service names from the allowed vocabulary, and edges strictly reflect drawn visual connections.
